query.text: 请帮我照看孩子，有危险或异常情况及时通知我。
query.text_en: Please help me watch the child and notify me immediately if there is any danger or abnormal situation.

annotation.text_zh: 宝宝在床上哭闹，快去看看吧。
annotation.text_en: The baby is crying in bed, go check on them.

annotation.text_zh: 家长已进入房间安抚宝宝。
annotation.text_en: A parent has gone into the room to comfort the baby.
